body.title: First-class 'ux' ReviewDimension: union literal + judgeUx + hasUxAcceptance gate
body.summary: Add 'ux' to the ReviewDimension union (types.ts:36). Add a judgeUx dimension judge (a dimensions/ux/ module, or alongside functional-coverage) that judges the built experience against the referenced ux-mock companion + authored uxDefinition and reports DimensionFinding{ dimension:'ux' } (HIGH when uxAcceptance required but no uxDefinition/ux-mock evidence). Add hasUxAcceptance(subject):boolean (true when the recorded adherence selection includes 'ux' OR a uxDefinition is present), mirroring hasFunctionalDefinition/hasDiagramReferences. Validate the recorded adherence selection against the AdherenceDimension set.
acceptanceChecks: judgeUx reports dimension:'ux'; emits HIGH when uxAcceptance is required but no uxDefinition/ux-mock is present
hasUxAcceptance returns true when the adherence selection includes 'ux' or a uxDefinition is present, false otherwise
the recorded adherence selection is validated against the AdherenceDimension set
